summary: The client's own project as far as their application needs it: enabled services, the identity it runs as, its secrets (values set from standard input, never in Terraform), and the rollout every Cloud Run service shares.

firebaseProjectId.label: Firebase project ID
firebaseProjectId.help: The Google Cloud / Firebase project this application uses, e.g. acme-crm-prod. It must already exist with Firebase enabled.

region.label: Region
region.help: The Google Cloud region the application runs in, e.g. asia-southeast1 for Singapore.

namePrefix.label: Resource name prefix
namePrefix.help: Short, lower case, e.g. acme. Prefixes every resource, so two applications in one project do not collide.

nextSteps: cd infra && terraform init && terraform validate && terraform plan
